g.text: Each line joins one condition; black bars show medians. Points show individual conditions.
Input and reference controls differ; reference controls are reused across conditions.
No donor/batch matching; conditions are not independent biological replicates.
The 5,000-gene source axis may reflect held-out cells; cell-level DE is not replicate inference.
MMD uses at most 100 cells per group. Internal exploratory analysis, not an official score.
